none: PAS FindID 982731: Roman Coin: Radiate indeterminate, pierced
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate indeterminate, later Roman issue of 260-296, pierced at 3 O'clock obverse with a round punched hole. Obverse description: Radiate head right, only one spike of crown shows clearly, clean-shaven. Obverse inscription: [--]VS A[V]G. Reverse description: Figure possibly standing left. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.98gms, die axis: 6
